```yaml
id: vuln-htmlunit-940dc7fd
languages:
  - java
message: Potential infinite loop in getNextElementUpwards method
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  CVE: CVE-2023-2798
  CWE: CWE-400, CWE-787
pattern: |
  $X = method(name="getNextElementUpwards" arguments=[$ARG0])
  exists($CALL : Call($X, $ARG1)
    where $CALL.get_parent().is($ARG0)
  )
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the vulnerable behavior of the `getNextElementUpwards` method in the `DomNode` class. It checks for a method call to `getNextElementUpwards` where the parent of the starting node is the same as the starting node itself. This could potentially lead to an infinite loop.

Please note that this rule does not cover the patched behavior. The patched version of the method does not return the result of the recursive call when `next` is `null`, which could lead to a different vulnerability.

This rule is generic and does not depend on any repository-specific names. It checks for the presence of the vulnerable method call in the codebase.
